structured.answer: The page says the cheapest is an account at פסגות with the fund 'אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125' (5112628, דמי ניהול 0.1%), leaving 86,045 ₪ after 10 years. The first bank is לאומי at 82,968 ₪. I don't know פסגות, so I won't do anything before asking my son or the bank.

Rows 3 and 10 seemed to fall between screens and I never saw them.
Many coloured lines. I didn't try to read it and stopped there, tired.
